summary: CLOSED THE RUN. Writes, all inside the exclusive scope and nothing outside it: package.json, README.md, docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md, and the new docs/SWARM_V14_PLAN.md (32,848 B). (1) NPM WIRING - four lines added to the end of the alphabetical block, one trailing comma on the previously-last verify:closure-bite line, nothing pre-existing renamed, reordered or removed: "verify:cranial-nerves", "verify:nerve-kind" (carried in from v13 by the platform task), and the two this task owns, "verify:cranial-nerve-courses": "node scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-courses.mjs" and "verify:cranial-nerve-render": "node scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-render.mjs". All 28 scripts resolve to existing files and BOTH new ones were then EXECUTED THROUGH npm, so the wiring itself is tested rather than asserted. (2) THE RUN'S PLAN/CLOSURE - docs/SWARM_V14_PLAN.md S1-S12: where the courses live and why not src/data/tracts.json (the course-author task built that first and withdrew it on measurement: 24 validator errors from the single id ledger, and a second table would draw every course twice under a toggle that does not reach it; tracts.json is byte-identical to base at 23 records); the TWELVE-ROW ANATOMY TABLE (nerve, root au, what it is anchored on with the measured deviation, foramen, target, waypoints, length au/mm, radius and its mm source, minimum CLIP_BOUNDS clearance) with the PUBLISHED CHORD TOTAL 500.62 au = 600.74 mm against the DRAWN Catmull-Rom arc 508.20 au = 609.84 mm (+1.5%, kept visible rather than dropped); the file-by-file delta of both builders; the SECTION-ROUTE MECHANISM WITH ITS PAYLOAD ARITHMETIC MEASURED INDEPENDENTLY with the shipped tubeGeometryFor over the shipped NERVE_COURSES - one tube 803 verts/1440 tris = 33.5 KiB raw / 14.7 KiB quantized, twelve tubes = 0.3929 MiB raw / 0.1724 MiB quantized, 24 tubes = 0.3448 MiB quantized, against the BINDING budget = the src/assets/anatomy directory at 14,566,178 B = 13.8914 MiB in 140 files with 0.1086 MiB of headroom (the manifest reading is 0.1849 MiB) - so the bake misses by 3.62x raw / 1.59x quantized and ROUTE (a) PROCEDURAL WINS AT 0 BYTES with the payload byte-identical; the 3D/2D SURFACE-PARITY EVIDENCE; eight itemised things that did NOT ship with reasons; and the claim tiers. (3) README - a new 'v14 - the cranial nerves as traveling tracts' section (twelve-row table, one-body-per-nerve XOR, both-surface table, the bake arithmetic, honest limits, the gate table) and, in the tier-list paragraph, the v14 sweep result plus the correction that the brief's 'known-red verify:area-toggles' note is STALE (it exits 0 with 455 assertions / 0 failed). The v13 honest limit that said 'the 2D live section and the PiP do not react to this toggle' is explicitly marked SUPERSEDED BY v14, and the Features bullet now points at v14. The HONEST-LIMITS ENTRY THE BRIEF REQUIRED IS THERE: the courses are AUTHORED PATHS through documented landmarks (root, cisternal segment, named foramen, target) with radii converted from stated cisternal calibres at 1 au = 1.2 mm, NOT segmented scans and NOT tractography; no skull-base/dural-sinus/orbit mesh is committed anywhere, so every foramen position is authored from anatomy; CN I and CN II are stated SEPARATELY (CN I has no brainstem root and no surf-cn1-exit, so its chain runs epithelium [11,9,66] -> bulb and ENDS on its own committed origin3d [8,12,48]; CN II is the one nerve with committed meshes and its authored tube OVERLAPS the baked tract-optic-nerve-l GLB by 26.2/1.9/36.8 au, so it draws a second optic nerve - that is the one place v14's own duplicate-body rule is not satisfied, reported not papered over). (4) docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md - AMENDMENT D with the new course collection and FULL GEOMETRY PROVENANCE (the authored waypoints and what each chain is anchored on at 0.000 au, the committed nucleus origin3d and exit landmark behind them, the r = d_mm/2.4 conversion with all twelve mm figures, the chord/drawn length pair, the 803-vert procedural tube, the procedural 2D part through the pre-existing registryPartFromGeometry adapter, 0 bytes of new payload, and the worker-measured contour counts), plus the correction of the two v13 lines that said the nerve slice reached neither the 2D section nor the PiP, and the three carried-forward defects. Chrome cannot start here, so verify:audit / verify:acceptance / verify:browser and every pixel claim are ORCHESTRATOR-ONLY and are named as such in both documents. ZERO PRODUCT-RED: I touched no source file - git status confirms my only modified paths are README.md, docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md and package.json (plus the new untracked docs/SWARM_V14_PLAN.md); every other dirty path is a builder's or the reviewer's. The known-red items were verified rather than assumed: verify:area-toggles is green (the brief's note was stale), and the v11 item-4 divergence (canvas painting divisions the rule excludes at y = 6/26/30/32) is closed with PARITY 6/6 at all four planes by executing the canvas' own buildLobeLayer over both committed ribbons - the product was never bent back to a stale gate.
